lead.question: 大使狼狈回家，却把荒唐遭遇讲得轻描淡写——他为何还说自己走运？
lead.warmup: 课文里，艾斯卡罗比亚大使回家吃午饭，却让妻子大吃一惊：他脸色苍白、衣衫凌乱。原来大使馆上午被人放火，他自己还被灭火器喷了一身，帽子也被子弹打穿。面对这一连串离奇事件，他却语气冷冷地娓娓道来。读这段对话前，先想想大使馆里究竟发生了什么，也留意本课出现的火灾、枪击以及大使、大使馆等相关词汇。
goals: 掌握 ambassador、embassy、fantasy、mess、shot 等本课词汇。
学会 set ... on fire、break out、go on doing、aim ... at、get ... posted 等短语。
理解并模仿与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句。
体会大使冷淡反讽的语气，把握对话中的间接引语与时态变化。
lead.summary: 《A fantasy》是一段对话体故事：艾斯卡罗比亚大使回家吃饭时狼狈不堪，衣服一塌糊涂。他向妻子解释，大学生上午放火烧了大使馆，地下室突然起火，他下楼查看时被霍斯特用灭火器喷了一身，因为霍斯特以为他着了火，他打算把那家伙打发走。夫人又发现他帽子上有洞，他答是有人从窗外开枪，幸亏当时没戴，否则就回不了家吃饭。标题暗示这番遭遇离奇得像虚构。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：break out 表示火灾、战争等“突然发生”，是不及物动词，没有被动语态，不能说 The fire was broken out。

questions.q: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
questions.a: Because he was not wearing his hat at the time. Someone fired a shot through his office window, which made a big hole in the hat; if he had been wearing it, he would not have been able to get home for lunch.
questions.aZh: 因为当时他没戴帽子。有人朝他办公室窗户开了一枪，帽子上被打了个大洞；如果他当时戴着帽子，就不能回家来吃午饭了。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后两句：Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time. If I had been... get home for lunch.

questions.q: Where did the fire break out, and what did the Ambassador do?
questions.zh: 火灾是从哪里烧起来的？大使做了什么？
questions.a: The fire broke out in the basement. The Ambassador went down immediately, and Horst aimed a fire extinguisher at him.
questions.aZh: 火灾是从地下室烧起来的。大使立刻下去了，而霍斯特把灭火器对准了他。
questions.hint: 见课文中间部分：The fire broke out in the basement... and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.

questions.q: What had happened to the Ambassador's clothes, and why?
questions.zh: 大使的衣服怎么了？为什么会这样？
questions.a: His clothes were in a frightful mess, because Horst had aimed a fire extinguisher at him, thinking the Ambassador was on fire.
questions.aZh: 他的衣服一塌糊涂，因为霍斯特以为大使身上着火了，把灭火器对准了他。
questions.hint: 见开头 his clothes were in a frightful state 一句及灭火器的解释。

questions.q: What did the Ambassador's wife suddenly notice, and how did he explain it?
questions.zh: 大使夫人突然注意到了什么？大使又如何解释？
questions.a: She suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat. The Ambassador explained that someone had fired a shot through his office window.
questions.aZh: 她突然发现丈夫的帽子上有个大洞。大使解释说，有人朝他办公室的窗户开了一枪。
questions.hint: 见后段对话：notice a big hole in her husband's hat 与 Someone fired a shot through my office window.

questions.q: Why is the story titled "A fantasy"? What does the title suggest?
questions.zh: 为什么课文标题叫“纯属虚构”？这个标题暗示了什么？
questions.a: The title is ironic: the Ambassador tells a string of absurd happenings—a fire, a fire extinguisher aimed at him, a shot through the window—so calmly and drily that the whole story sounds unreal, like a fantasy. The matter-of-fact tone makes real events read like fiction.
questions.aZh: 标题带有讽刺意味：大使如此平静、冷淡地讲述一连串荒唐遭遇——起火、被灭火器喷、有人从窗外开枪，使整个故事听起来不真实，像虚构一样。这种就事论事的语气让真实发生的事读起来倒像小说。
questions.hint: 结合 drily（冷冷地）一词与标题 fantasy 的含义。

exercises.q: 汉译英：大学生们今天上午放火点着了大使馆。
exercises.a: University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.

exercises.q: 选词填空（ambassador / embassy / fantasy）：①The ____ of Escalopia returned home for lunch. ②He works at the ____ in London. ③The whole story sounds like a ____.
exercises.note: 注意 ambassador 与人、embassy 与地

exercises.q: 句型转换：The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions.（用 continue 改写，意思不变）
exercises.a: The Ambassador's wife continued to ask questions. / The Ambassador's wife continued asking questions.

exercises.q: 汉译英：那个傻瓜霍斯特把灭火器对准了我。
exercises.a: That fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.

exercises.q: 汉译英：我一定要把那个家伙打发走（派走）。
exercises.a: I must definitely get that fellow posted.
exercises.note: get + 宾语 + 过去分词 使役式

exercises.q: 改错：The fire was broken out in the basement last night.
exercises.a: The fire broke out in the basement last night.
exercises.note: break out 不及物，无被动

exercises.q: 填空（用括号中动词的适当形式）：If I ____ (be) wearing it, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.
exercises.note: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句

quiz.q: 大使的衣服为什么一塌糊涂？
options: He was caught in a big fire.
Horst aimed a fire extinguisher at him.
He fell down in the basement.
Someone fired a shot at him.
The fire was broken out in the basement.
The fire broke out in the basement.
The fire broke in the basement.
The fire has broken out in the basement yesterday.
quiz.note: break out 不及物，无被动

quiz.q: I must get that fellow posted. 中 posted 的意思是：
options: Sent him away to another place.
Put up a poster for him.

quiz.q: 填空：The Ambassador's wife ____ asking questions.
quiz.note: go on doing 继续做同一事

quiz.q: 填空：The ____ of Escalopia returned home for lunch.
填空：If I ____ wearing it, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.
quiz.note: 对过去的虚拟用 had done
